title: Arkret Account Device Signer Evidence
description: Immutable Human account_device evidence for the existing directory/current-query contract. The authority_forward sibling in $defs alone also supports accepted Applet-managed real Account Devices, with its independent Event-bound original source. Neither branch adds a member to AuthenticatedSignerResolutionEvidence. signer_evidence_ref is SHA-256(RFC 8785 JCS of the complete object). Conformance vector ak.vector.device.account_device_signer_evidence.v1 checks the exact closure and negative mutations.

forward_account_device_signer_evidence.description: authority_forward-only complete original Station closure for Human or accepted Applet-managed real Account Devices, independently proven from accepted PCR purpose and original authorization. Never appears in current keys/query or peer directory; not an Agent, Service, controller or native authorization source.
